name: FanCAD Essentials
description: Drafting helpers written in JavaScript against the public plugin API. Bundled as a proof that the API is complete enough to build real commands with.

commands.title: Draw Grid
commands.description: Draws a rectangular grid of construction lines. Give the lower-left corner, the spacing, and how many cells in each direction.

params.name: spacing
params.description: Distance between grid lines, in drawing units

params.name: columns
params.description: Number of cells across. Defaults to 10.

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of cells up. Defaults to 10.

params.name: layer
params.description: Layer for the grid lines. Defaults to the current layer.

commands.title: Center Marks
commands.description: Draws crosshair center marks on every selected circle and arc. With nothing selected, marks every circle in the drawing.

params.name: ids
params.description: Circles and arcs to mark. Defaults to all of them.

params.name: oversize
params.description: How far the marks extend past the radius, as a multiplier.

commands.title: Bounding Box
commands.description: Draws a closed rectangle around the selection, or around the whole drawing when nothing is selected.

params.name: ids
params.description: Entities to enclose. Defaults to everything.

params.name: margin
params.description: Extra clearance around the box, in drawing units.

commands.title: Drawing Report
commands.description: Summarises the drawing: entity counts by type, per-layer totals, extents and total line length. Read-only.

commands.title: Divide Polyline
commands.description: Places points at equal intervals along a polyline or line, the way AutoCAD's DIVIDE does.

params.name: target
params.description: The line or polyline to divide

params.name: segments
params.description: Number of equal segments, at least 2
